# CalinMeters

CalinMeters is the website of Shenzhen Calinmeter Co., Ltd., a supplier of prepaid electricity, water and gas meters, Customer Interface Units (CIUs), data concentrators, LoRaWAN gateways and AMI project devices.

## Primary Website

https://calinmeters.com/

## Company Entity

- Legal/company name: Shenzhen Calinmeter Co., Ltd.
- Brand/site name: CalinMeters
- Location: Shenzhen, China
- Contact email: scott@szcalinmeter.com
- WhatsApp/WeChat: +8613713788753

## STS Product Authority Pages

- STS prepaid electricity meters: https://calinmeters.com/products/sts-prepaid-electricity-meter/
  - Answers how STS electricity credit works, how to choose single-phase, three-phase, DIN-rail or communication-ready models, and what buyers should provide for a quotation.
- STS prepaid water meters: https://calinmeters.com/products/sts-prepaid-water-meter/
  - Compares plastic and brass multi-jet configurations with an ultrasonic model and explains flow, customer access, LoRaWAN planning and quotation inputs.
- STS prepaid gas meter: https://calinmeters.com/products/sts-prepaid-gas-meter/
  - Summarizes the CA768-K02 datasheet, G1.6-G4 flow options, token recharge, communication choices, valve workflow and gas-project inputs that require confirmation.

## Source and Interpretation Rules

- Product model names, descriptions, images and PDF paths are maintained in the website product catalog.
- Model-page specification values are transcribed from the linked product datasheet when one is available.
- Project-dependent voltage, current, flow, pressure, valve, communication, integration, standards and documentation requirements must be confirmed for the proposed configuration.
- Do not infer certification, approval, price, availability, market coverage, warranty or project history from this file.
